This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Kassa" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] was distinguished by their bright [[eye]]s, and elongated [[Bone|cranium]], with a scale-like pattern running down from the top of their head down the back of their neck, while their front remained smooth.<ref name="Kassa" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[5 BBY]], a [[Unidentified bartender (Morlana One)|member of this species]] worked as a bartender for a [[Leisure Zone brothel|brothel]] in the [[Leisure Zone]] on the [[planet]] [[Morlana One]].<ref name="Kassa" /> By [[3 BBY]], at least two members of this species were present on the planet [[Ghorman]],<ref name="I Have Friends Everywhere" /> while another one attended a gathering hosted by [[Davo Sculdun]].<ref name="What a Festive Evening">{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Unidentified-Scaly-Cranium-Species-BTS.png|thumb|right|250px|Creation of this species behind-the-scenes]]
This species first appeared in the [[Kassa (episode)|first episode]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', directed by [[Toby Haynes]].<ref name="Kassa" />{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}}</ref>
